Ja'Marr Chase.note: Hyperextended knee at practice Aug 25, sat Aug 26 as precaution. Says he's 'fine' and would play if there were a game; expected ready Week 1 but hadn't resumed full practice as of Aug 26. Still worth top dollar — just confirm practice status draft morning.

Christian McCaffrey.note: Did not practice Aug 8-23 with 'tightness' (team framed as load management); returned to full 11-on-11 Aug 23 and expected to start Week 1 vs Rams. A 2-week August absence at age 30 with his history justifies not paying peak price, but he's draftable.

Jahmyr Gibbs.note: Back injury cost him first six camp practices, then a hamstring kept him out of preseason. Campbell says on schedule; Gibbs says near 100% and expects Week 1. Contract resolved (3yr/$67.5M). Risk is soft-tissue recurrence, not Week 1 availability.
Jahmyr Gibbs.src: detroitnews.com Jul 31 + Aug 6, 2026; detroitlions.com Lions Daily

Ashton Jeanty.note: Low (not high) ankle sprain Aug 23-25; as of Aug 27 'not cleared and not ruled out' for Sept 13 opener. Biggest injury cloud on a 1st/2nd-round asset — worst case looks like 1-2 games, so if the room panics and his price craters, buy the dip.
Ashton Jeanty.src: NBC Sports player news Aug 25, 2026; Las Vegas Review-Journal

Puka Nacua.note: Two overhangs: psoas soreness from Aug 11 (progressing, trending toward Week 1) and pending NFL personal-conduct review with a ~1-game suspension floated for the Week 1 Australia game. Combined worst case is ~1 game of 17 (~6%) — headlines may depress his price well below that.
Puka Nacua.src: therams.com injury update Aug 2026; sports.yahoo.com suspension report

Malik Nabers.note: ACL return: back in full-speed team drills, coach says 'reasonable to assume' Week 1 but Nabers won't commit, plus an Aug 26-27 early practice exit (team says no injury). Price in ~1-2 missed games plus an early-season ramp — roughly 5-10% of the season at risk.
Malik Nabers.src: SI Giants OnSI / Heavy.com / LastWordOnSports, Aug 26-28, 2026

Josh Jacobs.note: Groin resolved (returned Aug 18, team says no Week 1 impact). Real risk: formally charged Aug 27 with misdemeanor battery + criminal damage; NFL weighing personal-conduct discipline and GM says Packers are preparing for a suspension scenario. Unresolved 2-6 game suspension risk = roughly 10-35% of the season.
Josh Jacobs.src: RotoBaller/Heavy.com Aug 27-28, 2026; NBC Sports PFT Aug 18, 2026; ESP

CeeDee Lamb.note: Healthy — the flag is target-share erosion (8.4 targets/gm, 25% RZ rate as Pickens emerged as co-alpha). Still a first-round WR; trim the ceiling, don't avoid.

Justin Jefferson.note: Fully practicing, no injury. Drag is situation: career-worst 2025 and now tied to new QB Kyler Murray. Volume should hold; pay alpha-WR price minus a small situation haircut.

A.J. Brown.note: Traded to the Patriots June 1 (new QB Drake Maye, new offense, sat entire preseason). Physically fine — played through a dislocated thumb. Value him on the Patriots context, not his Eagles profile; the market fade may be roughly right, not an overreaction.
A.J. Brown.src: espn.com trade coverage; sports.yahoo.com thumb story, Aug 2026

Breece Hall.note: Non-contact groin Aug 17 with a 2-3 week timeline; Glenn says firmly on track for Week 1 vs Tennessee but he'll have little/no practice ramp. Groins linger — fine at a modest haircut, don't pay full price.
Breece Hall.src: newyorkjets.com practice report Aug 17, 2026; jetsxfactor.com Aug 18

Drake London.note: Minor shoulder from preseason Week 1 plus QB flux (Penix off ACL, Tua started the finale) — experts already cut him $70->$59. Injury is minor; the QB uncertainty is real. Draft at the marked-down price.

Omarion Hampton.note: Healthy, strong camp — but Chargers publicly threw cold water on a workhorse load, with Vidal and Mitchell slated for real committee work under McDaniel. Don't pay a $65 bell-cow price for a committee lead.

Kenneth Walker III.note: Now a Chief (4yr/$36M, March 2026). Swollen ankle held him out of the Aug 28 preseason finale; Reid expects him to 'be fine' but it's an active ankle issue ~2 weeks before the season. Confirm status draft morning.

Mike Evans.note: Now a 49er. Quad strain earlier in camp, then sat Aug 25 with a 'minor' groin — two soft-tissue issues at 33. 'Likely' for Week 1 in Australia. Draftable with an age/soft-tissue haircut.

Rashee Rice.note: Knee cleanup ramp is done (11-on-11 since ~Aug 11, cleared for Week 1, big projected role) and the suspension overhang looks dead — jail time served, Rapoport reports no further NFL discipline expected. If the room still prices in suspension fear, that's free value.
Rashee Rice.src: heavy.com / fantasylife.com Aug 12, 2026; si.com Chiefs camp reports

Sam LaPorta.note: Aggravated hip; Campbell 'feels like he should be OK for Week 1' but Lions aren't sure. Market ADP has slid well below his expert TE5 rank — experts call the discount undeserved. Buy the fear, with a small caveat for his 2025 back history (missed 8 games).
Sam LaPorta.src: si.com fantasy injuries; Detroit News / NBC Sports PFT Aug 20, 2026

Brian Thomas Jr..note: Landed on his left shoulder Aug 24, held out as a precaution; Coen: 'I think he's alright,' expected ready for the opener. Minor — pay normal price.
Brian Thomas Jr..src: Yahoo Sports / Big Cat Country Aug 25, 2026

DeVonta Smith.note: Hamstring strain Aug 3 wiped out most of camp/preseason; back to full practice ~Aug 24 and on track for Week 1 with almost no camp reps. Slight early-season ramp risk only.

DK Metcalf.note: Out Aug 8-24 with an undisclosed issue; back at practice, says he's fine for Week 1. Also note Pittsburgh added Michael Pittman Jr. — target competition caps the ceiling slightly.

Zay Flowers.note: Quad contusion Aug 8, then missed practices Aug 24-26 termed precautionary. Team and RotoWire expect him to play Week 1; ended camp not fully practicing. Minor.

David Montgomery.note: Traded to Houston and expected to open as the clear lead back ahead of Woody Marks — a value bump. Any room pricing still anchored to the Detroit committee role is stale; buy it.
David Montgomery.src: SI Lions OnSI / Pride of Detroit, offseason-Aug 2026

Travis Etienne Jr..note: Signed with the Saints (4yr/$48M), healthy — and Alvin Kamara's MCL sprain may hand him a true three-down lead role to open the season. Room may still price him as a committee back.

DJ Moore.note: Traded to Buffalo in March; healthy and slated as Josh Allen's primary weapon, but new offense and a more crowded target tree. Value him as a Bill, not Chicago's WR1.

Jaylen Waddle.note: Traded to Denver (Bo Nix / Sean Payton). Early-August leg tightness resolved — full-pads team drills in late August. Physically fine; just reprice for the new offense.
Jaylen Waddle.src: espn.com trade analysis; NBC Sports PFT, 2026

Emeka Egbuka.note: Toe sprain Aug 12; Bowles won't commit on Week 1 but the sprain is stable and analysts think he plays. With Mike Evans gone his target share rises when healthy — draftable at price.
Emeka Egbuka.src: si.com fantasy injuries; Bucs Nation, mid-late Aug 2026

Quinshon Judkins.note: 'Nagging' camp injury, held out mid-August as a precaution; back in team drills at full speed and Monken doesn't expect him to miss Week 1. Lead-back path intact.
Quinshon Judkins.src: si.com fantasy injuries Aug 19-25, 2026; NBC Sports PFT

Chuba Hubbard.note: Hamstring since ~Aug 13 (week-to-week, missed rest of preseason); team expects him back for Week 1. Added risk: Jonathon Brooks is back taking first-team reps — committee looms.

Jonathon Brooks.note: Finally healthy after two ACL years; strong preseason debut with the 1s and Canales says 'ready to rock.' But it's a committee with Hubbard (expected back Week 1) — workload unsettled, price accordingly.

TreVeyon Henderson.note: Right foot/ankle from slipping on turf ~Aug 24, called likely minor — but he was already losing the backfield to Rhamondre Stevenson, who's projected as the lead. Injury + role trend = pay change-of-pace price only.

Rico Dowdle.note: Listed as Warren's backup but splitting first-team reps evenly, and FOX's Vacchiano (via HC McCarthy) believes he ends up the workhorse in a run-heavy offense. If the room prices him as a backup, he's a value.

Jaylen Warren.note: Nominal starter but splitting reps evenly with Dowdle, whom insiders project as the eventual workhorse. Minor mid-August illness irrelevant. Don't pay lead-back price.

Tucker Kraft.note: Back from the Nov 2025 ACL — off PUP early August, first 11-on-11 Aug 17, expected to play Week 1 vs Minnesota. Green Bay being cautious; early-season snap counts may be limited.

Tyler Warren.note: Minor groin from the ~Aug 19 joint practice ('about a week'; team not worried about the opener), and experts already marked him down $21->$16. The markdown roughly matches the risk — draft at the reduced price.

Colston Loveland.note: No injury — DJ Moore's exit leaves a target vacuum and Ben Johnson historically funnels targets to his TE. Experts moved him $21->$31; if the room is anchored to last year's price, he's one of the best buys on the board.

Dalton Kincaid.note: Broken pinky he's managing without visible limitation is spooking drafters, while experts project an enhanced role in Pete Carmichael's offense. Classic case of a scary-sounding non-injury depressing price.

Justin Herbert.note: Herbert is healthy; his O-line isn't — C Biadasz expected out for the season (knee) and LT Slater missing practice. Most-hit QB in 2025. Market fade is rational; fine at the discounted price given the McDaniel OC upgrade.

Michael Pittman Jr..note: Traded to Pittsburgh (3yr/$58M). Healthy; sharing the room with DK Metcalf in a new offense — reprice off the Indy volume profile.

Stefon Diggs.note: Released by NE, signed with Washington ~Aug 5 (1yr/$12M) after a not-guilty verdict in May. Healthy, but a late signing means limited reps in a new offense next to McLaurin.

Josh Downs.note: 'Very minor' calf kept him out Aug 25-26 (plus an earlier groin blip); likely sits the preseason finale, ready for Week 1 vs Baltimore. Minor.

Alec Pierce.note: Missed the entire offseason and camp after ankle surgery; activated off PUP Aug 27 and signaling early-season availability, possibly Week 1 — but with essentially zero camp reps. Ramp risk only.

Luther Burden III.note: Groin Aug 8 cost him the whole preseason; returned to individual drills Aug 26, not on any injury list, expected available Week 1 once cleared. Ramping from a 3-week absence.

Quentin Johnston.note: Lower-body injury at the late-August 49ers joint practice; Schefter says not expected to miss much time, if any. Second minor issue of camp; WR2 behind McConkey with rookie Tre' Harris pushing. Minor.

Wan'Dale Robinson.note: Now a Titan. Took a heavy hit Aug 28 and was evaluated for a concussion — early word is he did NOT suffer one, team still monitoring. Verify draft morning; likely fine.

Jeremiyah Love.note: Cardinals No. 3 overall pick: high ankle sprain Aug 13, still not practicing in late August (light agility only). Team 'hopeful' for the opener but multiple outlets call Week 1 in real jeopardy — high ankles linger. Budget for ~2-3 missed games, roughly 12-18% of the season.

Jacory Croskey-Merritt.note: Lower-body injury Aug 20, held out of final two preseason games, plan is to practice the week of Aug 31. Commanders view him as RB1, but the room got crowded (White, Ford, Kaytron Allen). Fine at price.
Jacory Croskey-Merritt.src: cbssports.com; NBC Sports player news Aug 24, 2026

Jadarian Price.note: Seahawks first-round rookie: 'minor' lower-body soreness, held out of the last two preseason games largely as a precaution. Positioned for significant early work with Charbonnet still rehabbing his ACL.

Zach Charbonnet.note: On active/PUP in late August rehabbing an ACL tear; Week 1 uncertain. If he opens on reserve/PUP that's a minimum ~4 games — plan for roughly 25% of the season at risk.

Tyrone Tracy Jr..note: Went to the locker room during the Aug 28 preseason game with an apparent neck injury; severity unknown. Check status the morning of the draft before bidding.

KC Concepcion.note: Dropped 12 ECR spots with no justifying news — only a minor AC-joint sprain from Aug 3 that he returned from in two days, plus an excellent preseason with the 1s. Looks like rookie repricing, not an event; buy at the depressed price.

Blake Corum.note: No injury, glowing camp reports — but McVay plans a two-back split with Kyren Williams starting and preferred. Committee-price him despite the buzz.

Michael Wilson.note: Concussion protocol ~Aug 20; back participating and doing media by Aug 26. Trending fine for Week 1 but was in protocol within the last 10 days.

Marvin Mims Jr..note: Bruised foot in the Aug 28-29 preseason finale. Sounds minor but fresh — check draft-morning reports.

Parker Washington.note: Undisclosed injury, day-to-day, out of the mid-August preseason game; ESPN's DiRocco reported he was expected back for the finale. Trending available. Deep-league only.
Parker Washington.src: NBC Sports PFT Aug 18, 2026; ESPN via DiRocco

Bhayshul Tuten.note: No injury — listed 'Tuten OR Rodriguez' on the Jaguars depth chart, so the September backfield split is unresolved. Don't pay locked-in RB1 price.
Bhayshul Tuten.src: jaguars.com first unofficial depth chart, Aug 2026

Jeshaun Jones.note: Vikings WR suspended the first 3 games (substances of abuse) — ~18% of the season gone. Deep-league relevance only.
